notes.title: Hexguardian Heroes Update: A Divine Intervention - And a 33% Discount!
notes.content:
Hey there blessed Guardians!

The Gods of strategy are pleased to answer your prayers and are sending new heroes to join your battle! We're bringing you a game altar-ing update and to celebrate, there's a divine discount of 33% to bless your wallet that will run for 2 weeks from now! 

[h2][b]New Content: The Altar and Heroes[/b][/h2]

You're going to be worshipping at the shrine of strategy with this one! We are introducing 'Altars' to your roster of buildings in Hard and higher difficulties, as well as Weekly and Roguelike Challenges.

[h2][b]Heroes Arise![/b][/h2]

Each game, you can summon one hero from the Altar. These celestial champions come with:
[list]
[*] Core skills so powerful, they're basically sacrilegious! These recharge automatically over time and can be cast at your command.
[*] Three additional skills that can be learnt, because even heroes need education! These enhance your hero's abilities in conjunction with their core skill.
[*] Unrestricted movement anywhere on the map (unless there's a river, because these gods never learnt how to swim)
[*] Attack power that grows with each day, proving that practice makes perfect, even in heaven!
[/list]

[h2][b]The Sacred Roster[/b][/h2]

Say hello to the four new heroes that at your command:
[list]
[*] [b]Lyra, the Swiftarrow[/b], an archer whose [b]Rain of Arrows[/b] will have her enemies praying for cover!
[list]
[*][b]Core Skill: Rain of Arrows[/b] deals a wide AoE of physical damage. 
[*] Additional skills can enhance arrow frequency and unleash more devastating volleys after casting. It's raining cats and arrows!
[/list]
[*] [b]Ragnar, the Bloodfury[/b], a fierce warrior who is a bit of a zealot.
[list]
[*] [b]Core Skill: Frenzied Rage[/b] allows Ragnar to sacrifice his own blood to enter a berserker state, gaining buffs and dealing area damage effects. Talk about a blood donation!
[/list]
[*] [b]Isolde, the Lightbringer[/b], a knight equipped with SPF1000 against evil.
[list]
[*][b]Core Skill: Holy Shield[/b] creates a large magical barrier that protects and empowers all allied units within its range. Group hugs and smiting at three o'clock, anyone?
[/list]
[*] [b]Kael, the Wintermage[/b], a mage bringing you your Winter Wonderland fantasies!
[list]
[*] [b]Core Skill: Frost Domain[/b]: With this treasure, I summon... no wait, wrong universe! Frost Domain creates a powerful ice field on the map. Within this field, Kael's basic attacks hit multiple targets and freeze enemies instantly.
[*] Additional skills can cause Frost Domain to further boost allied units within its range.
[/list]
[/list]

So, what are you waiting for? Don't let this divine opportunity pass you by! Update Hexguardian today and experience tower defense so good, it's almost sinful! Remember, the 33% discount only lasts for 2 weeks! As always, let us know what you think by leaving us a review. Don't forget to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/W24zTeNX5j]Discord[/url] to talk about the game with other players just like you, and to keep up to date with the latest Hexguardian news and updates!

Lots of Love,
The Split Second Games and Yogscast Games Teams

[i]P.S. We apologize for the ungodly number of puns in this update. We got a bit carried away with the spirit of things. Please don't send us to pun purgatory - we're already working on our redemption arc![/i]

notes.title: Hexguardian Lava Land update out now—and 30% discount!
notes.content:
Hello Guardians!

Things are heating up in Hexguardian with our newest update—Lava land! This exciting new volcanic world is joined by new towers, new economy, and brand new wonders, creating a whole HOT NEW challenge to defend your castle!


[h2][b]New map: Lava Land[/b][/h2]

Welcome to Lava Land! Instead of beautifully clear rivers and lush vegetation, here you'll only find boiling streams of lava, withered trees, dry bones... and, of course, deadly volcanic eruptions. But don’t worry, volcanoes can be your own special weapon! When building new tiles, the tectonic movement will accelerate all volcanic eruptions and the lethal lava will inflict significant fire damage to all nearby enemies.

[h2][b]New towers: Rolling Log Tower & Shuriken Tower[/b][/h2]

Time to get on a roll with The Rolling Log Tower! This tower launches logs that, after hitting a target, will roll along the enemy's path towards the portal. Upgraded Rolling Log Towers will launch larger and sturdier logs that can roll further.

Let the throwing stars align against your enemies with The Shuriken Tower! This tower launches shurikens at all enemies within its range—make the enemies circle around it and deal tremendous total damage! Upgraded Shurikens will split into smaller shurikens upon hitting enemies, tracking nearby units and further punishing dense groups of enemies.

[h2][b]New Economic Building: Quarry[/b][/h2]

Searching for more stone to build new land tiles? Well the Quarry is your answer! This building benefits from the stone blocks on the surrounding tiles, so place it in areas with a high concentration of them to collect as much stone as possible!

[h2][b]New Wonders: Stonehenge and Oracle[/b][/h2]

Stonehenge has a chance to produce… you guessed it—Stone! It produces stone when nearby enemies die.

The Oracle is a wonder that responds to all who seek blessings from the gods. When you receive a blessing (either through talents or by praying at the castle), a flurry of lightning will strike down, hitting enemies around the Oracle.


So, are you ready to feel the heat in Lava land? Tell us what you think about the new realm by leaving us a review and as always, If you would like to keep up to date with the latest news on Hexguardian and future updates, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/W24zTeNX5j]Discord![/url]

notes.title: Hexguardian Inferno update out now - plus a 25% Discount
notes.content:
Hello Guardians! 

We're here to celebrate the Steam summer sale in style! Not only will you be able to pick up Hexguardian with a 25% discount, but the Hexguardian Inferno update is out now!  

Once you've mastered each biome in Crazy difficulty, you will now unlock Inferno difficulty. The sun won't be the only thing bringing the heat this summer! 

[h3][b]Inferno Difficulty [/b][/h3]

The Inferno difficulty lives up to its name, rewarding players for the highest score rather than longevity. Additionally, you can add one or more Mutators to the current Inferno level to increase the difficulty in various ways, and thus earn higher score bonuses. Each Inferno level will initially unlock 2 Mutators, and other Mutators can be unlocked by achieving a certain score in that level. The leaderboard for "Inferno" levels will record your highest score instead of the highest number of days survived.

[h3][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h3]

[b]Adjusted spell damage[/b]: Due to the automatic increase in spell damage as days progress, spells were dealing significantly more damage than towers and units as the number of days increased. This was impacting the diversity of strategies. Therefore, we have reduced the spell damage bonus increase per day.

[b]Enemy HP changes[/b]: Reduced maximum increase on HP and Armor of Enemy Land Units as days increase. The maximum HP and armor of enemy land units increased too quickly compared to water and air units as the game progressed. We have reduced this growth rate disparity to balance the units better.

[h3][b]Preview of things to come[/b][/h3]

A new map, buildings, and wonders with unique mechanics are in the works and will be added to Hexguardian soon! Get ready for new challenges!

We hope you enjoy the new difficulty mode and the balance changes, and we hope to see you setting some ridiculous high scores in the inferno mode. If you would like to keep up to date with the latest news on Hexguardian and future updates, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/W24zTeNX5j]DISCORD![/url]

notes.title: New Balance Patch (v1.09)
notes.content:
We have been reading the community discussions regarding balance issues. We've noticed that the differences in the strengths of towers, units, spells, and elemental reactions have been limiting the diversity of game strategies. Therefore, we have decided to release the v1.09 balance patch to address some of the current balance issues in the game.

[list]
[*] Reduced the range of the Conduct reaction and modified its effects: Now the Conduct reaction can only conduct to a maximum of 5 other enemies. 

We found that in the later stages of the game, the Conduct reaction could stun large groups of enemies, leading to unlimited enemy stacking and causing game lag. Additionally, the overwhelming crowd control effect of the Conduct reaction made it almost the only viable choice for reaching higher days in crazy levels, which contradicts our goal of promoting diverse strategies. Therefore, we have limited the maximum effect of the Conduct reaction.

[*] Adjusted the skills that can be acquired by Water Towers and Thunder Towers: For the same reasons, we have reduced the number of skills that increase attack range and attack speed for Water Towers and Thunder Towers, further limiting the effect of the Conduct reaction.

[*] Reduced the rate of increase in enemy HP and armor from day 20 onwards in all levels.
The rapid growth in enemy HP and armor after day 20 made "damage"-type defensive measures too weak compared to "control"-type defensive measures. Therefore, we have slowed down the rate of increase in enemy HP and armor, hoping that "damage"-type defenses will be more effective in the later stages of the game.

[*] Reduced the range of the Toxical Explosion reaction: Due to the stacking effect of the Toxical Explosion reaction, it could cause excessively powerful damage when enemies were densely packed.

[*] Increased the damage of all spells in the early stages of the game but reduced their damage in the later stages: Because the damage of spells automatically increased with the number of days, they were relatively weak in the early stages and too strong in the later stages. Thus, we have made this adjustment.

[*] We have strengthened the towers, units, and spells that were generally considered weaker based on feedback from the balance survey:

[olist]
[*] Increased the attack power of Cannon Towers, Light Towers, and Dark Towers
[*] Increased the attack speed of all mages and the healing speed of priests
[*] Increased the maximum HP of melee units
[*] Increased the duration of Heal and Encourage
[/olist]
[/list]

notes.title: "At Your Request" Update: Assign Attack Priorities, Wiki Upgrade, Talent Reset
notes.content:
Hexguardian has been live for two weeks now, and we have felt the enthusiasm of our players deeply. We have also received a lot of valuable feedback. We are here with our "At Your Request" update, providing the most requested features and improving the gaming experience.

[b]Assign Attack Priorities:[/b]

You can now assign up to three layers of attack priorities to all allied towers and units! You can set default priorities for towers/units in the wiki (newly built towers and newly recruited units in the game will apply this default priority) or individually assign priorities to each tower/unit in the game.

Before each attack, allied towers and units will consider all available targets and select the optimal target according to your assigned priorities. You can choose to have your arrow towers prioritize flying units, have your elemental towers target units not in an abnormal state, or have your archers focus on ships and target the ship with the lowest hp. Fully utilize your imagination and command skills to design attack priority settings that best suit the current situation, which will greatly assist you in defeating your enemies!

[b]Wiki Upgrade:[/b]

Now, clicking the "More Info" button on an wiki card will display detailed information about the item, including basic stats, attack targets, and attack priority settings.
Please note that the basic stats here do not include bonuses from unlocked talents or other buffs.

[b]Talent Reset:[/b]

If you are not satisfied with your current talent unlock arrangement, you can reset your talents in the talent interface. To ensure that the talent reset function is not overused, resetting talents will only refund 80% of the trophies spent on unlocking them.

If you enjoy our game, please write a review for us! If you want to join discussions about the game or provide feedback, we welcome you to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/W24zTeNX5j]Discord[/url] group!

notes.title: Additional supported languages added to Hexguardian!
notes.content:
Hello Guardians!

We are ecstatic to see so many people playing and enjoying Hexguardian! We want to say a big thank you to everyone who has supported the game.

We are also pleased to announce we have added additional languages to Hexguardian. You will now be able to play the game in the following languages:
[list]
[*] French 
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Russian
[*] Portuguese (Brazil).
[/list]
We're excited to bring the game to a new audience who may not have picked it up previously due to it not being supported in these languages! 

We've also been working on a whole host of other improvements including:
[list]
[*]  Improved camera zoom allowing you to zoom out much further to get a full view of the map
[*]  Ultrawide support: the game will now display better on monitors with a wider aspect ratio
[*] You are now able to rotate the camera
[*]  A whole host of balance changes and bug fixes
[/list]
and we will continue to work on other improvements and fixes into the future!

We've also made major changes to the demo, bringing all the quality you have come to expect from the full game but with limited free content.

If you've been enjoying Hexguardian so far, it would be wonderful if you could leave a review! This really helps us out in a meaningful way as it helps us get new eyes on the game, and opens up more possibilities for the future!

You can also join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/W24zTeNX5j]DISCORD[/url] where we are currently running the Portal Immortal challenge. Head over to the official Discord for information on how you could be in the running to win 1 month of full Discord Nitro!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.03
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed the limit on zooming out the camera, now the camera can zoom out to the maximum distance.
[*] Added support for ultra-wide screen displays, now the game can be displayed properly on ultra-wide screens.
[*] Fixed the bug where sandstorms would cause a significant amount of damage to friendly units in the late game (now the damage to friendly units does not increase with the number of days).
[*] Fixed the issue where upgrading cards was prone to accidental touches (now requires a 1.5-second delay before clicking).
[*] Fixed the bug on the Rockland map where the melee barracks rally point couldn't be moved to the roads between the canyons.
[*] Increased the maximum health and attack power of all friendly melee units.
[*] Increased the damage dealt by spells (especially in the late game).
[*] Decreased the maximum HP and armor of enemy ships.
[*] Reduced the probability of getting oasis tiles and single-road/single-river tiles appearing in this week's "Crazy Portal" challenge (it isn't changed in normal games).
[/list]

Fixed the bug on the Rockland map where the melee barracks rally point couldn't be moved to the roads between the canyons.

tags.balance_change: Increased the maximum health and attack power of all friendly melee units.
Increased the damage dealt by spells (especially in the late game).
Decreased the maximum HP and armor of enemy ships.
Reduced the probability of getting oasis tiles and single-road/single-river tiles appearing in this week's "Crazy Portal" challenge (it isn't changed in normal games).

notes.title: v1.01 & 1.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Added support for camera rotation (using the <- and -> keys) and camera reset (using the home key).
[*] Implemented support for unrestricted frame rates (FPS) which can be chosen in the settings menu.
[*] Weekly challenge content for next week.
[*] Reduced the increase in enemy HP and armor on days 4, 9, 15, and 19.
[*] Fixed bug causing shortcut keys for buildings to become scrambled.
[*] Resolved issue where players were prone to accidental card selection at the start of each day.
[*] Fixed bug causing significant camera displacement when moving the camera while the game was paused.
[*] Fixed bug where players who have played the demo version were not receiving the "Complete Tutorial" achievement.
[*] Fixed bug where some players were not seeing roguelike challenges.
[*] Fixed bug causing repeated selection of the same map multiple times.
[/olist]

We are paying attention to feedback and issues raised by players in the Steam comments, forums, surveys and Discord channels. We will address game issues and make adjustments as quickly as possible. However, due to limited resources (this is a solo-developed game), not all feedback can be immediately addressed. We appreciate your understanding!

Additionally, our translation support team has nearly completed translations for French, German, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, and Portuguese(Brazil), which will be implemented soon.

notes.title: Hexguardian is out now with a 20% launch discount!
notes.content:
Hello Guardians - the day is finally here! We are excited to announce that Hexguardian is out now! We can't wait to see you placing tiles, building towers, positioning your troops, and shutting down the portals by closing the loops.

A lot has changed since the demo we launched at NextFest. We now have a variety of maps, each with their own unique features. We've also added a Weekly Challenge mode, that will be updated with a unique theme and challenge every week! Select perks, units and a blessing to compete on the global leaderboard.

[previewyoutube=5ykCS3tMxjw;full][/previewyoutube]

You can expect all this great content and more with a 20% launch discount for the next 2 weeks!

We have some exciting activity lined up for those who want to celebrate in style:
[list]
[*] We will be answering community questions on the Yogscast subreddit, so if you want to ask any questions about the game, development or anything else, drop by [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Yogscast/]HERE[/url]! 

[*] There will also be a Yogscast live stream of the game at 17:00 BST / 12:00 EST, which will be broadcast on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCH-_hzb2ILSCo9ftVSnrCIQ]Youtube[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/yogscast]Twitch[/url] and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2381740/Hexguardian/]Steam store page![/url] 

[*] And finally, you can join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/W24zTeNX5j]Discord[/url] to chat about the game, discuss strategies, and show off your runs!
[/list]
We really hope you enjoy Hexguardian - and if you would consider leaving a review, this would help us out a lot!

notes.title: Hexguardian Patch Notes v0.54
notes.content:
Dear Guardians:

We have made significant balance adjustments in the new demo version v0.54. Our aim is to provide a more diverse and variable strategic gaming experience by allowing different strategies to flourish in the game. If you'd like to share your thoughts on the new balance, feel free to click the "Feedback" button on the main interface or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/W24zTeNX5j]DISCORD[/url] community. And if you are enjoying our demo, please don't forget to WISHLIST Hexguardian on Steam!

[h3][b]A List of changes can be found below:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] All levels are endless now! But it will get really hard after day 20.
[*] Now, every 15 talents unlocked will grant you a "Talent Lock". "Talent Locks" can be used to "temporarily lock" talents, preventing their appearance in-game. "Temporary locking" talents can be undone at any time outside a level.
[*] Bosses come on Day 10 instead of Day 7 in Hard levels.
[*] Increased coin production from all houses and Fishing Huts.
[*] Significantly increased coins obtained from chests.
[*] Significantly increased star production from Observatories.
[*] Now, shuting down all portals grants an additional 200% star bonus (previously 100%).
[*] Burning effect now causes HP lose when the unit receives damage (health loss doesn't count as damage).
[*] Increased Cannon Tower's damage.
[*] Increased attack of all allied units, but extended their revive time.
[*] Reduced damage caused by Sandstorms, but now Sandstorms only deal half damage to allied units.
[*] Increased Poison's damage , but reduced its damage on bosses.
[*] Increased Thunder's damage, and now it deals double damage to flying enemies, but reduced its damage on bosses.
[*] Reduced hp of Galleys, but decreased their appearance interval.
[*] Reduced hp of Sail Boats, but they now have armor.
[*] Reduced hp and armor of Airships.
[*] Defeating bosses now grants more coins.
[*] Some initially weaker blessings received significant buffs.
[/list]

Hexguardian Development Team
